per_finding_dispositions.authority: Each full body has exactly one current owner. CURRENT byte-identical aliases only may be CONTEXT_ONLY. No unchanged-body omission, old verdict inheritance or delta-only acceptance. Combined approval requires every owner and parent verification.

T1-1.title: fixture failures lose descriptor ownership evidence
T1-1.repair: Test-owned raw descriptors are registered before os.open (fixture_open: OSError not_acquired, otherwise acquisition_uncertain) and closed at most once via fixture_close; run_filter/scripted_filter register the capture file before creation, close it at most once while fixture-owned, retain it UNKNOWN after an ambiguous reader start and record the reader's single close.
independent_test_oracles: t_fixture_fd_handoff_ownership: fifo_writer close/close-failure, run_filter capture closed once / ambiguous retained
T1-1.residual_or_conditional: Python-managed 'with open' fixture file creations elsewhere are unchanged (not raw descriptors).

T3-1.title: corruption fixture loses raw-descriptor ownership
T3-1.repair: Corruption and replacement descriptors registered via fixture_open with observed identity, closed once via fixture_close; restoration requires proven closure.

T3-2.title: endpoint checker accepts missing acquisition history
T3-2.repair: Checker takes the scenario's expected acquisitions as an independent ledger (flags, numbers, available observations; unexpected endpoints must show non-acquisition), requires the writer's registry record, EBADF-only closure; replacement rehash observation compared with the independently captured replacement fingerprint; unavailable-fstat negatives.

T3-3.title: raw-inventory oracle excludes an orphaned anchor
T3-3.repair: Production treats 'anchored' as resolved only when TREE owns the exact fd+observed identity; the oracle now expects the orphan (and incoherent resolved-looking records) in the production unresolved set.

T3-4.title: acquisition-before-allowance ordering untested
T3-4.repair: Acquisition crossing the original allowance and a late successful nonempty read refuse with exactly one close and no further reads; production adds explicit post-acquisition fences.

T3-5.title: nested-identity coverage omits contradiction branch
T3-5.repair: Valid outer/nested PID disagreement retains both identities with explicit uncertainty; independent omission of EVERY identity (including both summary-derived) refuses.
